name: the plain shape
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: block comment, then COMMIT
nested block comment, then COMMIT, on its own line
nested block comment, then COMMIT, on an existing line
text:
SELECT 1; /* a /* b */ c */ COMMIT;
DO $e$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: nested block comment, no COMMIT
COMMIT after a dollar-quoted body with a tag
$$ inside a string literal, then COMMIT
$$ inside a string literal
the final RAISE inside a handler that swallows it
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END; END $e$;

name: the final RAISE inside IF false
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN IF false THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END IF; END $e$;

name: RETURN before the final RAISE
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN RETURN; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: a conditional RETURN before the final RAISE
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN IF true THEN RETURN; END IF; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: RETURN in a nested block before the final RAISE
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN BEGIN RETURN; END; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: a labelled EXIT that leaves the block
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ <<o>> BEGIN EXIT o; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: a labelled EXIT inside a loop
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ <<o>> BEGIN LOOP EXIT o; END LOOP; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: EXIT outside any loop
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN EXIT; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: EXIT inside a loop ends only the loop
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN LOOP EXIT WHEN true; END LOOP; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: a handler on a nested block before the final RAISE
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN BEGIN PERFORM 1; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: a handler on the outermost block, after the final RAISE
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END $e$;

name: a CASE expression before the final RAISE
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN PERFORM CASE WHEN true THEN 1 END; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: a word RETURN inside a string
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN PERFORM 'RETURN'; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: another upper-case marker
text: DO $e$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OTHER_MARKER %', 1; END $e$;

name: a line comment holding COMMIT after the result block
a statement after the result block
a statement after the result block, no semicolon
a block comment after the result block
a nested block comment after the result block
two result blocks
the final RAISE is a NOTICE
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN RAISE NOTICE 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: top-level END
top-level BEGIN
top-level SAVEPOINT
top-level PREPARE TRANSACTION
lower-case commit and chain
'COMMIT' in a string inside a DO body
an unterminated dollar quote, then COMMIT
text:
DO $q$ x;
COMMIT;

name: an E-string with a backslash quote (one string; a false red, the safe direction)
commits: ends in a result block
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: commits: a top-level COMMIT
text:
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1);
COMMIT;

name: commits: a plain write
text: INSERT INTO t VALUES (1);

name: commits: ends in a block that RETURNs before its RAISE (it commits)
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN RETURN; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: fragment: a setting
text: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s';

name: fragment: a nested-comment COMMIT
text: /* a /* b */ c */ COMMIT;

name: a word BEGIN used as an alias, then a handler on the outermost block
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN PERFORM 1 AS begin; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL; END $e$;

name: a handler on the outermost block whose last statement is a RAISE
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ BEGIN PERFORM 1; EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;

name: a word LOOP used as an alias, then a labelled EXIT
text:
SELECT 1;
DO $e$ <<o>> BEGIN PERFORM 1 AS loop; EXIT o; RAISE EXCEPTION 'X_RESULT %', 1; END $e$;
